name: OpenTable
summary: Look up restaurants, check availability, and monitor health on OpenTable

tools.name: opentable_lookup
tools.description: Look up an OpenTable restaurant by its URL slug (e.g. 'carbone-new-york' from opentable.com/r/carbone-new-york) to get its numeric restaurant ID.

tools.name: opentable_availability
tools.description: Check real-time availability for a restaurant on OpenTable. Returns available time slots with booking URLs.

tools.name: opentable_heartbeat_check
tools.description: Check whether the OpenTable integration is healthy. Verifies both restaurant lookup and availability queries.
